total_model.summary: Model projects 43.6 total points (GB 25, CAR 19). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.1), Combined rush defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.7), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
